title: Clusters and Prisms
summary: **Clusters and Prisms** fuse shards into one off-hand item. A Cluster joins two shards, and an Apex Prism joins five plus a Cluster.

blocks.p: Fuse them in the Shards section of `/craft`, or win them from the [Shard Crate](/wiki/smp/crates/). Each recipe uses up the [shards](/wiki/gear/shards/) it is made from.

ul: {{icon:cluster_strength_vigor}} A Cluster gives the effects of its two shards.
{{icon:warmongers_prism}} An Apex Prism gives the effects of five shards and needs a Cluster as well.

blocks.p: Hold one in your off hand and right-click to use its ability (a few need sneak and right-click). Each ability has a set number of charges and a cooldown.

ul: Build the Cluster before the Apex Prism that needs it.
Clusters and Apex Prisms cannot be salvaged, so the shards inside them are gone for good.
